payload.recallText: Im a third grade teacher and want to teach my students about the history of the oregon trail. Im like a puppet master with my students when teaching them to study about the states and use characters like cheezy pizza and ceasar von salad. Its hard to teach 9 year olds about the westward expansion especially one student alex asked if it was going to be a game. We begin the lesson in manhatten and while on the trip one child askes for water and i replied they did not have water fountains along the oregon trail but not to be in trouble with the parents i allowed them to have water. My teaching style for the oregon trail was like a combination of the old oregon trail video game and dungeons and dragons.
